answer: Price each answer in verifiable work metered per identity from a per-key seed, so no single computation feeds two keys, like nectar a bee can store in only one cell. One miner pays the cost once an epoch through a single inlet of effort; a farm pays it per fake and cannot pool the lotus-root of shared precomputation across heads. The marginal cost per identity stays flat, which keeps honest scale cheap and makes sybil scale grow linearly in real resources spent.
